current_best.description: Simplify the reward function by removing redundant components and focusing on core tracking with potential-based shaping. Removed multiple overlapping penalty terms and consolidated the reward structure. (rationale: The current reward function has multiple overlapping penalty terms for angular velocity (smoothness_penalty, velocity_penalty, smoothness_bonus, high_velocity_penalty, oscillation_penalty) that create conflicting signals and make learning difficult. By simplifying to just smoothness_penalty and velocity_penalty, we provide clearer feedback to the agent. The baseline metrics show excellent performance (lateral_error: 0.0041), so we can afford to simplify without losing tracking quality. This reduces reward complexity while maintaining the core tracking objective and potential-based shaping, which should lead to more stable learning and potentially better generalization.)
